reviews.title: Thank You
reviews.text: I use this for my devotions but haven't found how to use it at church yet because we use a different version of the Scriptures. Seems my medications have reduced my IQ,PTSD etc. I enjoy the this app but I can’t login because I no longer can remember my password and we no longer email because we’ve moved years ago to the South and they have a different internet system. So I have been hitting the “X” to open the app.
